Go and gather the elders of Israel together, and tell them, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of…
“Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against…
and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my…
‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?
No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.
He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and pervert all equity.
translations.bsb: Now hear this, O leaders of the house of Jacob and rulers of the house of Israel, who despise justice and pervert all that is right,
translations.kjv: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.
translations.asv: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, that abhor justice, and pervert all equity.
